messages:
Asha: Morning — quick sync: who can own the release train today? feature branch is serve-batching + a tiny infra tweak. Prefer 09:30 ET slot. TL;DR: no DB schema changes, just config flips.

Tom: I can run the deploy. 09:30-09:45 ET works. Plan is canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2m pause checks. I'll post rollback steps here.

Marcos: I'll take smoke ownership. Will run the smoke script and validate traces + SLOs. @Tom please link the deploy ticket once you reserve the slot.

Tom: slot booked in the ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RT-425 — canary thresholds + target hosts listed. Quick rollback notes: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:previous && ./scripts/rollback.sh rt-425`

Priya: FYI DB replica lag is ~80ms right now (caught by monitoring). Good for reads in this deploy but flagging in case anyone plans heavy read sampling during canary. I'll keep an eye.

Claire: Minor suggestion — split API deploy from workers to reduce blast radius. API first, workers later.

Tom: good call. Updated plan: API at 09:30 ET, workers at 10:00 ET if API is green. That avoids coupling and gives time to roll back before any worker churn.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: slot reserved rt-425 by Tom for 09:30 ET (slot id: rt-20231128-05). Reminder: paste smoke_output to this thread after checks.

Marcos: I'll paste the smoke-run I'll use pre-release:
```
# run from ci/ops box
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env prod --targets=api,worker --trace --short

# expected quick output snippet
OK api:200 p50=95ms p95=210ms
OK worker:200 p50=60ms p95=120ms
KV_CACHE: warm
TRACES: endpoints sampled
```

Marcos: Ran the smoke locally against the canary subset just now — results below. Minor p95 bump on api to 120ms during a brief spike but no errors. Ready to go :thumbsup:

```
# actual run 1701234568
OK api:200 p50=98ms p95=120ms
OK worker:200 p50=58ms p95=110ms
KV_CACHE: warm
Errors: 0/200 requests
```

Asha: Great — @Tom start at 09:30 and ping here when you hit 25% canary. If anything crosses the thresholds (Priya's >5% error rule or >300ms p50), immediate rollback and call @oncall.

Tom: Copy. I will annotate the deployment steps in RT-425 and post canary updates here. Rollback plan staged and tested locally.

Priya: Monitoring hooks: dashboards pinned under /releases/rt-425. I'll trigger pager if >5% error rate OR sustained p50 >300ms for 2m.

Claire: Added a short post-deploy checklist to the ticket (integration smoke, traces, cache warm, profiling snapshot). If you want, I can take the worker deploy at 10:00.

Tom: Thanks — please take workers if API green. I'll start API rollout at 09:30 and post timestamps for each canary percentage.

Marcos: I'll be on-call for smoke validation till 10:15. Good luck y'all. :rocket:
